items.raw_excerpt: Dutch flying car maker PAL-V has been given the go-ahead to start building something that could be in the skies in 2028. items.summary_en: A Dutch company called PAL-V has received approval from European aviation authorities to begin building flying cars. The company, based in Noord-Brabant, has been working on the design for 20 years and aims to have cars in the skies by 2028. CEO Robert Dingemanse said production will start soon now that all permits are in place.
